# tests/badge - the coverage badge is honest (gap 44).
#
# The badge shown by the README is generated by tools/quality/coverage_badge.py
# from the measurement of the `coverage` job of quality.yml, and checked by
# its --check mode. This test exercises the generator and the check: a badge
# edited by hand and a record too old must both be rejected, otherwise the
# badge would be decoration.
#
# This directory brings its own CMakeLists.txt, so it is registered
# automatically by tests/CMakeLists.txt.

add_test(NAME badge-check
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/badge_check.py")
set_tests_properties(badge-check PROPERTIES
    TIMEOUT 60
    LABELS "badge")
